description: This line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity of four different model configurations across varying ratios of activated parameters. The x-axis is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" and features a reversed linear scale decreasing from left to right, with a range from 100 to 25 and tick marks at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL." and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 11.0 to 14.5, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal dashed grid lines at intervals of 0.5. The "Transformer" configuration is represented by a brown dashed line with no markers, which remains constant at a value of approximately 11.6 across the entire x-axis range from 100 to 25. The "Only MoHD FFN" configuration is shown as a solid gray line with square markers; it starts at approximately 11.4 at an x-value of 100, remains steady at 11.4 at x=75, dips slightly to approximately 11.3 at x=50, and then rises to end at approximately 11.8 at x=25. The "Only MoHD ATTN" configuration is depicted by a solid dark gray line with circle markers, beginning at approximately 11.4 at x=100, increasing to 11.6 at x=75, rising to approximately 12.25 at x=50, and reaching a peak of approximately 14.3 at x=25. Finally, the "MoHD ATTN + MLP" configuration is represented by a solid blue line with 'x' markers, starting at approximately 11.4 at x=100, increasing slightly to 11.5 at x=75, continuing to rise to approximately 12.05 at x=50, and ending at approximately 13.2 at x=25.
